lines.l: How little things can slip out of your hands
Why things don't always turn out as you planned
These are things that I don't understand
Yeah, these are things that I don't understand
I can and I can't decide
Day on the day for night
Why everything will dissolve into sand

These are things that I don't understand
Yeah, these are things that I don't understand

Time, on the dark for life
But I love, but I love this life
